segments.name: Sally Beauty
segments.description: An omni-channel retailer offering professional-quality beauty supplies at attractive prices to retail consumers and salon professionals in North America, South America and Europe.
segments.evidence: Sally Beauty ("Sally") – An omni-channel retailer that offers professional-quality beauty supplies at attractive prices and provides education to retail consumers and salon professionals throughout North America, South America and Europe.

segments.name: Beauty Systems Group
segments.description: A full-service omni-channel distributor offering professional beauty supplies exclusively to salons and licensed beauty professionals in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: Beauty Systems Group ("BSG") – A leading full-service omni-channel distributor that offers professional beauty supplies exclusively to salons and licensed beauty professionals throughout the U.S. and Canada.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling beauty products to retail consumers through Sally stores and digital platforms, and to salons and licensed professionals through BSG stores, consultants and digital platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: Sally operates primarily through retail stores (generally operating under the Sally Beauty banner) and digital platforms, including our www.sallybeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and third-party digital marketplaces.
